body:
**Consolidation & taxonomy**
- Make `test/runtests.jl` the source of truth: register all standalone and GPU test files with a `tier` (unit/inference/conv/allocs/smoke/gpu/misc), a `subsystem`, and a `slow` flag; match filename prefixes to tiers (`unit_`, `inference_`, `conv_`, …); document the conventions in `test/README.md`.
- Rebuild the Buildkite pipeline around the harness: one job per subsystem on CPU and GPU, plus one per tier, replacing the single-process steps that duplicated them.
- Keep the two-core GitHub runners inside their budget. GHA and Downgrade skip `slow` tests and the tiers that repeat their cases or run end-to-end (conv/inference/allocs/smoke), which Buildkite covers. Downgrade also drops `:inference`, whose JET counts are pinned to the Manifest and drift under forced-oldest dependencies. Unit tests go from hitting the 80-minute timeout to ~45 minutes.
- Add CG/DG integration smoke tests (Bickley jet, column advection, solid-body rotation, baroclinic wave) and DG interface-flux and stability property tests.
- Probe all four divergence forms (strong, weak, split, DG) with vector spherical harmonics, whose divergence is pointwise-exact at every wavenumber: post-DSS max-norm accuracy up to the element resolution limit, the pre-DSS inter-element jump, and its O(h^(Nq−1)) refinement rate (measured 2.82 against a design rate of 3 for Nq = 4).
- Sweep Float32 and Float64 across DataLayouts, CommonSpaces, Spaces, and Operators; parameterize the shared 2D/3D test utilities by `FT`.

**Fixes**
- Fix the Bickley jet DG flux: physical velocity components were labeled contravariant, so the volume term disagreed with the interface Rusanov flux by the metric factor π/4. Both forms now build from one physical flux function.
- Fix GPU kernel compilation in the bidiag-matrix-row test (`Base.Fix1` holding a `Type` is not a bitstype) and allocation-test failures that came from measurement rather than allocation: an inline `@allocated f(...)` depends on the caller's inlining budget, so it now runs from `@noinline` wrappers.
- Merge `:opt` into `:inference`; JET's `@test_opt` is a type-stability check, so the two tiers tested the same thing. The tier runs under both `--check-bounds` settings, since JET reads the optimized IR and a bounds check that fails to compile under only one setting would otherwise go unnoticed.
- Set `CLIMACOMMS_DEVICE=CUDA` on two "cuda" MPI jobs that ran on CPU; drop a duplicate Integrals perf step; add assertions to three tests that checked only that nothing threw; promote the advection-convergence job from soft to hard.
- Restore GPU matrix-field broadcasting coverage: a CPU umbrella over all 22 cases in the harness, and a Buildkite matrix running each case as its own GPU job. Several need minutes of ptxas apiece, and sharing a process starves the assembler, which is SIGKILLed partway through `test_scalar_15`. A README maps each `test_scalar_*`/`test_non_scalar_*` filename to the expression it tests.
- Instrument coverage only on the job that uploads it. `if: ${{ a }} && ${{ b }}` interpolates each `${{ }}` separately and leaves the string `"true && false"`, which is truthy either way, so codecov uploaded from every job in the matrix. Instrumentation also bypasses the precompiled pkgimages, making an instrumented run ~2.5x longer, and is what killed the 1.11 jobs near the end of the suite: with coverage off it passes the test that killed it (172 tests, 30.0 s), with coverage on it is killed ~16 s in, and 1.10 passes either way.
- Raise the RootSolvers and ClimaComms compat floors; reformat for JuliaFormatter v2.10.1.

**Known soft failures**: three GPU matrix-field broadcasting cases (`test_scalar_14`, `test_scalar_15`, `test_non_scalar_2`) and 2-rank GPU distributed remapping.
title: Test suite consolidation, dual-precision expansion, and CI stabilization.

body:
## Purpose

Closes #1432.

`Base.any(fv::FieldVector)` was defined as `any(identity, A)` in `src/Fields/fieldvector.jl`, where `A` does not exist in that scope. Calling it threw:

```
julia> Yb = Fields.FieldVector(b = fill(false, space));

julia> any(Yb)
ERROR: UndefVarError: `A` not defined

julia> all(Yb)   # the parallel method, which correctly uses `fv`
false
```

This has been broken since the method was introduced in cf826d31 (2021-11-10), which is why nothing downstream depends on it.

While confirming this, I also verified that the feature #1432 actually asks for — `any(isnan, Y)` on a `FieldVector` — already works via the predicate methods on the two lines above:

```
any(isnan, Y)     -> false
parent(Y.u)[1] = NaN
any(isnan, Y)     -> true
all(isfinite, Y)  -> false
```

So #1432 is closed by this PR: the requested behaviour is present, and the one adjacent method that was genuinely broken is now fixed.

## Content

- `src/Fields/fieldvector.jl`: `A` → `fv`.
- `test/Fields/unit_field.jl`: new `FieldVector any/all` testset covering both the zero-argument `any`/`all` methods (the regression) and the predicate forms including `any(isnan, Y)`.

Verified locally on Julia 1.10.11 against the `.buildkite` project: the new testset passes 9/9, and the rest of `test/Fields/unit_field.jl` is unaffected.
